result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_degree()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get the degree of a node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13407-L13472){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_degree(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Node degree](/assets/graphs/algo-degree.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A focus node in the accent color at the center of the frame, connected by four incident edges to four neighbor nodes at the corners. A single non-neighbor node above the focus is not connected to it. A muted caption below the focus reads 'degree = 4'." width="100%"} For directed graphs, returns total degree (in-degree + out-degree). For undirected graphs, returns the number of neighbors. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID or label. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Degree of the node. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#cdd2246c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("A", "C") ) graph.get_degree("A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#0582a4a3 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.get_degree("B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: In directed graphs, degree counts both directions combined -- here "A" has one outgoing and one incoming edge, for a total degree of `2`: ::: {#fec291b5 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") # out for A, in for B .add_edge("C", "A") # in for A ) graph.get_degree("A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
